title: Random Projections for Multi-Copy Quantum Algorithms
summary: Estimating nonlinear properties of quantum states is a central task in quantum information science. Multivariate traces, $\mathrm{tr}(ρ_1 \cdots ρ_K)$, and nonlinear observables such as $\mathrm{tr}(ρ^K)$, for integer $K$, can be accessed through collective measurements on multiple state copies, but standard protocols based on swap tests require coherent operations on the full Hilbert space and become experimentally unfeasible for large systems.
